description: Servizio WMS Volo SNAM 1979 is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by antincendio.regione.abruzzo.it. The service dynamically produces the map of the flight plan relating to the recovery commissioned by SNAM Rete Gas S.p.a., for the relief of the territory between the areas of Pescara, Ortona, Vasto, Chieti and Cupello in 1979. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "WMS Flight SNAM 1979 Service" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include infoMapAccessService, fotografia aerea (immagine), servizio, wms, consultazione. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
